- **"Since" means after 28 Sep 2026,** the last action in our previous answer. Our data runs only to 30 Sep 2026, so any later agency action isn't in it yet.

sql.sql: SELECT r.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, r.AGENCY, r.RATING, r.RATING_DT, r.OUTLOOK FROM dbo.RATING r JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=r.ENTITY_ID WHERE le.ENTITY_NM LIKE '%Halvorsen%' OR le.ENTITY_NM LIKE '%Kestrel%' ORDER BY r.ENTITY_ID, r.AGENCY, r.RATING_DT

SELECT (SELECT MAX(RATING_DT) FROM dbo.RATING) AS latest_rating_action_any_entity, (SELECT MAX(SNAP_DT) FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE) AS cm_latest, (SELECT SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT=(SELECT MAX(SNAP_DT) FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE) AND ENTITY_ID IN ('LE-10001','LE-10022','LE-10004','LE-10003','LE-10002','LE-10023','LE-10008','LE-10006','LE-10005','LE-10011','LE-10012','LE-10009','LE-10024','LE-10010','LE-10016','LE-10026','LE-10014','LE-10015','LE-10017','LE-10025','LE-10018','LE-10019','LE-10020','LE-10021')) AS cm_exp, (SELECT MAX(LIMIT_AMT) FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID='LE-10001') AS group_limit

SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) commit_amt, MIN(RISK_RATING) min_rr, MAX(RISK_RATING) max_rr FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY WHERE FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND FACILITY_ID IN ('F0000001','F0000002','F0000003','F0000004','F0000005','F0000006','F0000007','F0000008','F0000009','F0000010')
